authoritative_records.name: ProductLine
authoritative_records.owns: reusable product/service classification identity independent of Customer

authoritative_records.name: Contract
authoritative_records.owns: customer-specific commercial/operational contract identity under exactly one Customer Organization

authoritative_records.name: ContractProductLine
authoritative_records.owns: association between Contract and Product Line plus current SLA-policy revision

authoritative_records.name: SLAPolicyRevision
authoritative_records.owns: effective tiers/thresholds/template provenance and immutable revision identity

authoritative_records.name: SRClassification
authoritative_records.owns: reviewed current/previous SR-to-CPL assignment with provenance

authoritative_records.name: IndividualSLAProjection
authoritative_records.owns: derived current duration/state for one eligible classified SR; rebuildable

authoritative_records.name: SLACohortProjection
authoritative_records.owns: derived monthly membership, denominator/numerator bounds and cohort state; rebuildable

authoritative_records.name: CompletedReportEvidence
authoritative_records.owns: immutable accepted-state/report provenance and represented results after artifact verification

identity_rules: Product Line identity is never Customer-scoped.
Contract Product Line identity is Customer-scoped through its Contract.
SR classification references CPL identity, not a copied Product Line label.
Policy revisions are immutable historical identities; current policy selection may change without rewriting prior revisions.
Cohort identity never includes compliance outcome/state.
projection_rules: Current individual SLA values are derived from accepted facts and current accepted policy/classification.
Current cohort results are derived from canonical monthly membership and current accepted inputs for the requested as-of boundary.
Completed report results are immutable evidence even when later live projections change.
